verification.independent_validation_limit: 24 saved final files verified; intermediate120 device parity checks attested by sealed native receipt
verification.external_binary_runtime_bridge_limit: No Linux reads; saved runtime seals crosschecked against compiled binary/source/input pins

method.delta_sign: positive means stock slower than mixed
method.warmup_policy: only iterations 0..3 excluded; all 96 measured pairs retained
method.exploratory_intervals: mean +/- t*sampleSD/sqrt(n); df15 pairs and df7 adjacent two-order blocks
method.interval_limit: Exploratory within this one serial run; alternating order is deterministic, cases not randomized, independence not established; no population 95% or causal claim
method.outliers: per-case branch1.5*IQR flags retained; host>10ms flags retained; leave-one-out ranges are influence diagnostics only

pooled_descriptive.weighting: equal 16 samples in each of six fixed cases; not live acceptance weighting

decision.candidate: PLD NPU-prepared prefix with native correction
decision.reason: Exact isolated GPU arithmetic passes, but observed mean branch budget is 0.2..17.6 microseconds with small samples/order/outlier sensitivity; no demonstrated margin for live C/J or early producer coverage
